title: Quilltap Character Progressions
description: Schema for the value of the reserved `progressions` key in a character vault's `metadata.json` — the timed spans (a pregnancy, a recharging cannon, a fermentation) whose elapsed, remaining and percentage state Quilltap computes and reports to the character each turn. Every OTHER key in metadata.json stays freeform; only this one is validated. Kept in sync by hand with the Zod schema in lib/progressions/schema.ts, which is the runtime source of truth.

propertyNames.description: The progression's id — a stable identifier a Pascal tool file addresses as `progress.<id>.<field>`, decoupled from the display `name`, which the user may edit freely.

name.description: How the progression is named in the report the character reads ('Pregnancy', 'Cannon recharge').

description.description: One sentence in the SECOND person, in your own words, prefixed to the default in-progress report and available to a custom template as {{description}}. 'You are carrying a child.'

startTime.description: When the span began, as an ISO-8601 instant with an offset or Z. Wall-clock time, never the chat's fictional clock.

endTime.description: When the span ends. Must be strictly after startTime — a rule this JSON Schema cannot express, but the runtime enforces.

timeIncrement.description: The unit the report SPEAKS in — 'week' for a pregnancy, 'minute' for a recharge. It never affects computation, only phrasing (and the `increment` cadence). Spans render as whole units of this plus a remainder in the next finer one: '20 weeks, 3 days'. Month and year are fixed-length (30.436875 and 365.2425 days), so the arithmetic is deterministic and calendar-free.

percentageReport.description: Whether the DEFAULT report includes ', 45% complete'. A custom reportTemplate uses {{percent}} regardless of this flag.

reportFrequency.description: When a prompted turn mentions this progression. 'turn' = every turn. 'increment' = only when the whole-unit count of timeIncrement has ticked over since this character last spoke. '<n><unit>' with unit s/m/h/d/w = at most once per wall-clock bucket of that period ('1h' = once per clock hour). A progression whose updatedAt is newer than the character's last turn reports regardless.

quantity.description: An optional scalar the span fills, rendered by {{quantity}} as 'current/total unit'. Current is derived (total × clamped percent ÷ 100), never stored.

total.description: The full amount reached at endTime — 1.0 for a cannon that stores one megajoule.

unit.description: What the amount is measured in: 'MJ', 'litres', 'rounds'.

precision.description: Decimal places for both current and total.

reportTemplate.description: Overrides the IN-PROGRESS wording only (the not-yet-started and complete states are short and fixed). Plain substitution, no logic; an unknown placeholder is left exactly as written. Placeholders: {{name}}, {{description}}, {{elapsed}}, {{elapsedWhole}}, {{remaining}}, {{remainingWhole}}, {{percent}}, {{quantity}}, {{start}}, {{end}}, {{increment}}.

onComplete.description: 'keep': once endTime has passed, the completed state keeps being reported on the same cadence ('complete; 3 days past due'). 'once': the completion is reported exactly on the first turn after it happened, then the progression goes silent — it stays in the file, still readable by a Pascal tool, until you or a tool removes it.

updatedAt.description: Stamped by the Aurora editor and by Pascal's applier on every write. An entry updated since the character last spoke is reported regardless of its cadence, so a re-armed cannon is announced immediately. Omit it when hand-editing and the next report simply waits for the cadence.
